_note: Checklist items for the learning hub. Goals G1-G7 = report §2.1; invariants I1-I8 = §10.2; questions Q1-Q5 = §13.2; routes = §7.4; corrections = §1.3. The 'protects' field is an editorial cross-reference written for this book (not stated in the report) and is conservative: it names only the goals an invariant plainly serves.

zh.title: 持续整数相位观测
zh.accept: CNT 记录实际 CKV 周期，不是只在目标命中时才记录命令状态

en.title: Continuous integer phase observation
en.accept: The CNT records the actual CKV cycles, rather than recording the command state only when a target is hit

zh.title: 高位降速
zh.accept: 宽位高位允许在 /4 或 /8 域工作，少量低位状态可继续高速运行

en.title: High-bit rate reduction
en.accept: The wide high bits are allowed to operate in the /4 or /8 domain; a small number of low-bit states may keep running at high speed

zh.title: 原周期编号不丢失
zh.accept: 相位模型可追溯到所选原始 CKV 节点，而非只保留慢时钟边沿

en.title: Raw cycle index not lost
en.accept: The phase model is traceable to the selected raw CKV node, rather than retaining only slow-clock edges

zh.title: 粗细观测一致
zh.accept: coarse 与 fine 对应同一物理锚点，或携带显式、可验证的坐标变换

en.title: Coarse/fine observations consistent
en.accept: Coarse and fine correspond to the same physical anchor, or carry an explicit, verifiable coordinate transformation

zh.title: fine 真实量程受控
zh.accept: 目标为约一个原始 CKV 周期或更小；必须按真实输入间隔检查

en.title: True fine range under control
en.accept: The target is about one raw CKV cycle or less; it must be checked against the true input interval

zh.title: 边界与故障可辨识
zh.accept: wrap、采样错配、无效码、饱和、丢沿、重复沿不能静默变成有效相位

en.title: Boundaries and faults identifiable
en.accept: Wrap, sampling mismatch, invalid codes, saturation, missing edges and duplicate edges must not silently become valid phase

zh.title: P/S 不替代 CNT
zh.accept: P/S 或 slot executor 负责物理边沿执行，不删除参考相关的 coarse 测量

en.title: P/S does not replace the CNT
en.accept: P/S or the slot executor is responsible for physical edge execution and does not remove the reference-related coarse measurement

zh.text: 实际 CK0 周期连续，N=MC+q 的原点与 carry 一致
zh.handling: 阻断有效相位；检查复位/极性/计数实现

en.text: The actual CK0 cycles are continuous, and the origin of N=MC+q is consistent with the carry
en.handling: Block the valid phase; check the reset/polarity/counter implementation

zh.text: coarse 与 fine 同锚点，或显式记录锚点变换
zh.handling: 校正或 INVALID，不静默相加

en.text: Coarse and fine share the same anchor, or the anchor transformation is explicitly recorded
en.handling: Correct, or INVALID; never add them silently

zh.text: correction 的单位和可覆盖错误集合明确

en.text: The units of the correction and the set of errors it can cover are explicit
en.handling: Mark invalid when out of bounds; do not truncate to ±1

zh.text: J_observed 反映真实执行，不由 J_plan 自证
zh.handling: 标记回执未证实，不进入 fine_valid

en.text: J_observed reflects the real execution and is not self-certified by J_plan
en.handling: Mark the receipt as unverified; it does not enter fine_valid

zh.text: fine 量程、码合法性和校准全部满足
zh.handling: 降级使用 coarse/区间/无效

en.text: The fine range, code legality and calibration are all satisfied
en.handling: Downgrade to coarse / an interval / invalid

zh.text: 两种边界候选在共同坐标下等价
zh.handling: 不一致视为 coarse/fine stitching 错误

en.text: The two boundary candidates are equivalent in a common coordinate
en.handling: Inconsistency is treated as a coarse/fine stitching error

zh.text: 低速计算符合选沿 deadline
zh.handling: late/miss，或重新规划并更新 J

en.text: The low-speed computation meets the edge-selection deadline
en.handling: late/miss, or re-plan and update J

zh.text: 全 counter rollover 采用明确模运算窗口
zh.handling: 超出可展开范围时 reset/reacquire

en.text: Full-counter rollover uses an explicit modular-arithmetic window
en.handling: Reset/reacquire when beyond the range that can be unwrapped

zh.q: 到底以哪个节点作为原周期？
zh.artifact: clock-node 表与全部倍率/相位原点

en.q: Which node exactly serves as the raw cycle?
en.artifact: Clock-node table with all ratios and phase origins
en.done: CNT, FCW, TDC, DTC and edge ID in the same units

zh.artifact: 全 residue、wrap、候选切换真值表
zh.done: 每个允许状态都对应合法锚点或 INVALID

en.q: How are C and q related at the boundary?
en.artifact: Truth table covering all residues, wraps and candidate switches
en.done: Every permitted state corresponds to a legal anchor or INVALID

zh.q: 低位如何控制真实选沿？
zh.done: 不能生成过去边沿；late/miss 行为确定

en.q: How do the low bits control the real edge selection?
en.done: No past edge can be generated; late/miss behaviour is deterministic

zh.artifact: J_observed 电路与独立校验路径
zh.done: 计划错误/丢沿注入后不会自证通过

en.q: Who proves the actual edge index?
en.artifact: J_observed circuit and an independent check path
en.done: After injection of plan errors or missing edges, it does not self-certify as passing

zh.artifact: 物理量程预算、SAT/VALID、校准/降级规范
zh.done: 饱和码不作为精确 fine，coarse 仍可解释

en.q: When can the short TDC be trusted?
en.artifact: Physical range budget, SAT/VALID, calibration and downgrade specification
en.done: Saturated codes are not used as an exact fine value; coarse remains interpretable

zh.name: 路线 A：多候选捕获与安全路径选择
zh.solves: 避开特定边界附近的危险采样位置
zh.needs: select 稳定、元组原子选择、固定/变化延迟

en.name: Route A: multi-candidate capture and safe path selection
en.solves: Avoids dangerous sampling positions near specific boundaries
en.needs: Stable select, atomic tuple selection, fixed or varying delays

zh.name: 路线 B：沿计数传播方向匹配采样时刻
zh.needs: PVT min/max、同一逻辑 epoch、复位与采样脉冲宽度

en.name: Route B: sampling instants matched to the counting propagation
en.solves: Counter bits that do not propagate in step
en.needs: PVT min/max, the same logical epoch, reset and sampling pulse width

zh.name: 路线 C：有界错配与冗余校正
zh.solves: 有界、可辨识的 epoch 不一致
zh.needs: 故障集合覆盖、修正单位、歧义时 INVALID

en.name: Route C: bounded mismatch and redundant correction
en.needs: Coverage of the fault set, correction units, INVALID when ambiguous

zh.text: 不能通用地写成 8C+q+e/8+ε。q 可能已包含 e 所表达的整周期位置；e/8 的单位也可能是分频后周期，不是原始 CKV 周期。必须先统一时钟节点、相位原点和量纲。

en.text: The general form 8C+q+e/8+ε cannot be used. q may already contain the whole-cycle position that e expresses; the unit of e/8 may be the divided period, not the raw CKV period. The clock node, phase origin and units must be unified first.

zh.text: 不能把所有 epoch 错配都归结为 ±1 个原始周期。高、低位在组边界撕裂采样时，典型错误分别相对合法状态为 −M 与 +M。/8 高位错一组与 raw-CKV 错一周期是不同故障。

en.text: Not every epoch mismatch is a ±1 raw-cycle error. When high and low bits tear at a group boundary, the typical errors are −M and +M relative to the legal state. A high-bit error of one /8 group and a one-cycle error on the raw CKV are different faults.

zh.text: Sony 不是“此前没有共享状态方法”的证据起点。Havens 专利已同时包含整数计数、小数检测、sub-fractional TDC，以及利用小数状态消除 one-count uncertainty 的处理。Sony 的贡献定位为另一条明确、紧凑的共享状态与修正实现。

en.text: Sony is not the starting point of evidence for 'no earlier shared-state method'. The Havens patent already combines integer counting, fractional detection, sub-fractional TDC and handling that uses the fractional state to remove the one-count uncertainty. Sony's contribution is a different, explicit and compact shared-state and correction implementation.
